lore.item.aether_charges.frost_charge: A shard of ambrosium wrapped in icestone. It bursts into a patch of cold, and the Sun Spirit hates it: hit it and the thing freezes as if its own ice crystal struck it.
lore.item.aether_charges.blaze_charge: A core ground from hellfire stone. Throw it and the landing spot burns for a good while.
lore.item.aether_charges.thunder_charge: A bolt of lightning that never fell, sealed in angelic stone. It falls where the charge lands.
lore.item.aether_charges.cloud_charge: Packed aercloud. It does not hurt much; it simply pushes whatever it hits along its path, the way a Zephyr pushes travellers off the islands.
lore.item.aether_charges.frost_scepter: Found deep in the bronze dungeon. No ammunition, only patience: it throws another ice crystal once it has recovered.
lore.item.aether_charges.blaze_scepter: A treasure of the gold dungeon. The fire crystal is the Sun Spirit's own trick; with this in hand it is yours too.
lore.item.aether_charges.thunder_scepter: Silver dungeon loot, once the Valkyrie Queen's. In her hands the thunder was a punishment; in yours it is a tool.
lore.item.aether_charges.cloud_scepter: Another bronze dungeon find. A flick of the wrist sends a cloud out to shove things aside.
aether_charges.configuration.title: Aether Charges
aether_charges.configuration.frost_speed: Flight speed of the frost charge (the Aether's own ice crystal).
aether_charges.configuration.frost_damag: Damage dealt by the frost bolt.
aether_charges.configuration.frost_freez: Whether the frost bolt freezes the Sun Spirit, like the Aether's own ice crystal.
How long the Sun Spirit stays frozen, in ticks.
Flight speed of the mod's own crystal bolts.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_cool: Cooldown after throwing a single-use charge, in ticks.
aether_charges.configuration.scepter_coo: Cooldown after casting with a scepter, in ticks.
aether_charges.configuration.blaze_damag: Damage dealt by the blaze bolt.
aether_charges.configuration.blaze_ignit: Seconds the blaze bolt sets the target on fire.
aether_charges.configuration.thunder_dam: Damage dealt by the thunder bolt.
aether_charges.configuration.thunder_sum: Whether the thunder bolt calls down lightning.
aether_charges.configuration.cloud_damag: Damage dealt by the cloud bolt (0 by default: knockback only).
aether_charges.configuration.cloud_knock: Horizontal knockback strength of the cloud bolt.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_dama: Damage multiplier for single-use charges; scepters use the full value.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_spee: Projectile speed multiplier for single-use charges.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_knoc: Knockback multiplier for the cloud charge.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_free: Freeze duration multiplier for the frost charge.
aether_charges.configuration.charge_igni: Ignite duration multiplier for the blaze charge.
